steps.title: Complete robot
steps.instruction: Compare the complete R20 robot before assembly. The standing pose and part placements come from the published FreeCAD assembly.
steps.inspect: Match each part ID to the BOM. Inspect print quality and interfaces before installing hardware.
steps.limits: Exploded separation illustrates access; it is not a collision-validated insertion path.

steps.title: 01 · Feet and ankles
steps.instruction: Pair each rigid foot with its TPU sole. Identify the ankle horn and opposite bearing support, then inspect the sole fixings and skate locating features.
steps.tools: Hex drivers matching selected fasteners; caliper
steps.inspect: Check left/right orientation, bearing seating, free ankle motion and sole contact. Retain access to the skate latch and locator pins.
steps.limits: Skate removal travel and the final axle/fastener stack need physical verification. No compatible purchased skate is implied.

steps.title: 02 · Leg subassemblies
steps.instruction: Assemble shank and thigh around the HD-1910 servos, horns and supports. Use the component view to identify each joint centre before installing outer covers.
steps.inspect: Verify servo orientation, horn seating and access to retaining screws on both sides. Keep wiring clear of the joint sweep.
steps.limits: Do not use the standing pose as a servo electrical-zero reference. Horn calibration follows the joint contract.

steps.title: 03 · Hips and trunk
steps.instruction: Join the leg subassemblies to the trunk through the hip yaw, roll and pitch interfaces. Inspect the compact second supports before tightening the assembly.
steps.inspect: Confirm both support sides seat without forcing. Inspect the load path from trunk through horn and bearing support.
steps.limits: Fit, support stiffness and insertion order need a real assembly trial. No tightening torque is specified.

steps.title: 04 · Electronics
steps.instruction: Review the Radxa Zero 3W, Pollen HAT, two IMU locations, camera, ToF and battery envelopes. Install and test board supports before closing the shell.
steps.tools: Caliper; board standoffs selected after fit checks
steps.inspect: Check board dimensions, connector height, mounting clearance and removal access. Keep actual pack sensing separate from the regulated 5 V servo rail.
steps.limits: NFC, audio and some power hardware remain provisional. Displayed envelopes do not establish connector or electrical compatibility.

steps.title: 05 · Neck
steps.instruction: Assemble the neck supports and head pitch/yaw interfaces around the established axes. Keep horns, bearings and retention points accessible.
steps.tools: Matching hex drivers; servo alignment reference
steps.inspect: Check free motion at each joint independently before fitting the head shell. Confirm cables can pass without pinching.
steps.limits: Sampled CAD clearance checks do not validate combined motion or cable bending. Do not power the robot from this guide.

steps.title: 06 · Head and direct-drive jaw
steps.instruction: Fit the current R20 head core and matching jaw mechanism. Identify the direct-drive servo and opposite hinge support; retain the pin and verify moving/fixed interfaces.
steps.tools: Matching driver; caliper; 40 mm test ball
steps.inspect: Inspect hinge seating and screw access, then manually check closed, 15° and 30° jaw positions against the CAD study.
steps.limits: This is the R20 direct-drive mechanism, not the historical R07 crank linkage. Grip force and jaw travel require physical checks.

steps.title: 07 · Cable routing
steps.instruction: Route actual servo leads and camera cable only after connector dimensions and bend limits are available. Leave service access and strain-relief provision around each joint.
steps.tools: Actual selected harnesses; continuity meter for an approved wiring plan
steps.inspect: Inspect moving joints, shell edges and board connectors for pinch points. Label cables and record measured free length.
steps.limits: No verified harness path or pinout is provided. No animated line should be interpreted as an approved electrical connection.

steps.title: 08 · Covers and colour parts
steps.instruction: Fit the face, eye details and outer covers after mechanism checks. Attach the R20 removable head band using its provisional M2 screw/washer/nut arrangement.
steps.inspect: Confirm tool access and removal without disturbing the head mechanism. Inspect band seating and ensure optics remain unobstructed.
steps.limits: Band screws, washers and nuts are absent from source CAD. Guide wireframes are provisional fit envelopes, not manufacturer geometry. M2×10 with 0.5 mm washer remains provisional; confirm the real stack before purchase.

steps.title: 09 · Final inspection
steps.instruction: Return to the assembled view, compare both sides and record fit observations before any powered commissioning.
steps.inspect: Log revision, material, print settings, fastener substitutions and measured clearances. Report each change with photographs.
steps.limits: No step is physically verified yet. This guide does not certify structural strength, electrical safety or learned motion.
